# beste-ui

> A modern React component library built on shadcn/ui. Copy and paste beautiful, accessible UI blocks into your Next.js and React projects. Production-ready and free to start.

## About beste.co

Beste is the site builder with strong constraints. No drag and drop, no inline chaos, no code. Just structured blocks designed to work together.

- **Website**: [beste.co](https://beste.co)
- **Philosophy**: Opinionated, block-based website building
- **Approach**: Pre-designed blocks that compose into complete pages

## About beste-ui

beste-ui is a curated collection of 168 production-ready UI components designed for modern web applications. Built on top of shadcn/ui, each component combines the power of:

- **React 19** - Latest React features and patterns
- **Tailwind CSS 4** - Utility-first styling
- **Radix UI** - Accessible component primitives
- **Framer Motion** - Smooth animations
- **TypeScript** - Full type safety

## Installation

Components can be installed using the shadcn CLI. The default `/r-base/`
URLs serve Base UI variants (shadcn's current default primitive library);
projects still on Radix-based shadcn should use the `/r/` URLs instead.

```bash
# Base UI (default)
npx shadcn@latest add "https://ui.beste.co/r-base/{component-name}.json"

# Radix
npx shadcn@latest add "https://ui.beste.co/r/{component-name}.json"
```

For example, to install the hero7 component:

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add "https://ui.beste.co/r-base/hero7.json"
```

## Component Reference

### About

#### Mission Band With Principles

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/block/about69
- **Install**: `npx shadcn@latest add "https://ui.beste.co/r-base/about69.json"` (Radix: `/r/about69.json`)
- **Description**: A company story section that runs a two-column heading over a wide photo band, then sets three founding principles as numbered hairline columns underneath.

#### Company History Rows

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/block/about70
- **Install**: `npx shadcn@latest add "https://ui.beste.co/r-base/about70.json"` (Radix: `/r/about70.json`)
- **Description**: A company story told as hairline rows keyed by a light year figure, set against a media column that sticks while they scroll and stacks an image tile floating a live growth metric over a captioned photograph.

### Agency

- **Install**: `npx shadcn@latest add "https://ui.beste.co/r-base/agency24.json"` (Radix: `/r/agency24.json`)
- **Description**: A four-step studio brief where the tall photograph beside it changes with the question on screen, each with its own caption, and sending the brief swaps the plate for the studio and the form for a ledger of the answers.

### Auth

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/block/auth1

- **Description**: Full-height centered sign-in screen with social login providers, email and password fields, a show/hide password toggle, remember-me checkbox, and forgot-password link. Perfect for SaaS apps, dashboards, and member portals.

#### Split-Screen Sign Up

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/block/auth2

- **Description**: Full-height OTP verification screen with a centered icon, segmented six-digit code input, a verify button that unlocks once the code is complete, and a live resend countdown timer. Perfect for two-factor auth, magic links, and email confirmation flows.

## Components

The primitives every block is built from. Free, no license needed.

### Chart

#### Area Chart

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/area-chart
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/area-chart`
- **Description**: Recharts area chart on the shadcn ChartContainer: multi-series with per-series gradient fills, optional stacking, grid, y-axis, legend, and a theme-aware tooltip. Config-driven colors via --chart tokens.

#### Bar Chart

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/bar-chart
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/bar-chart`
- **Description**: Recharts bar chart on the shadcn ChartContainer: grouped or stacked multi-series bars with rounded corners, optional grid, y-axis, legend, and a dashed-indicator tooltip. Config-driven colors via --chart tokens.

#### Line Chart

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/line-chart
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/line-chart`
- **Description**: Recharts line chart on the shadcn ChartContainer: multi-series lines with configurable curve, optional dots, active-dot hover, grid, y-axis, legend, and a theme-aware tooltip. Config-driven colors via --chart tokens.

#### Pie Chart

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/pie-chart
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/pie-chart`
- **Description**: Recharts pie/donut chart on the shadcn ChartContainer: per-slice colors from config, adjustable donut hole, optional legend, and a name-keyed tooltip. Config-driven colors via --chart tokens.

#### Radar Chart

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/radar-chart
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/radar-chart`
- **Description**: Recharts radar chart on the shadcn ChartContainer: multi-series polar areas with a polar grid, angle axis, adjustable fill opacity, optional legend, and a theme-aware tooltip. Config-driven colors via --chart tokens.

#### Radial Chart

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/radial-chart
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/radial-chart`
- **Description**: Recharts radial gauge on the shadcn ChartContainer: a single value plotted as a proportional ring with a muted track and a centered percentage plus caption. Ideal for progress, targets, and completion rates.

### Dashboard

#### Calendar Month

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/calendar-month
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/calendar-month`
- **Description**: A month grid with selectable days, a today marker, colored event dots per day, and prev/next month controls. Data-driven (weekStart + daysInMonth) so it renders deterministically; controlled or self-managed selection.

#### Color Picker

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/color-picker
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/color-picker`
- **Description**: OKLCH-native colour picker: a gamut-aware lightness and chroma plane, RGB and OKLCH tabs whose rows show their own colour ramp on hover, a field that accepts hex, rgb() or oklch(), screen eyedropper and preset swatches.

#### Data Table

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/data-table
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/data-table`
- **Description**: Client-side data-table engine: column-driven config with custom cell renderers, sortable headers, keyword search, row selection, per-row action menus, and pagination. Owns all state; blocks pass columns + rows as data.

#### Notifications Menu

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/notifications-menu
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/notifications-menu`
- **Description**: Topbar bell trigger with an unread count and a popover feed: icon rows with title, description, timestamp, unread dots, a mark-all-read action, and a scrollable list. Manages read state internally.

#### Schedule Timeline

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/schedule-timeline
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/schedule-timeline`
- **Description**: A Gantt-style day timeline: resource rows against an hour axis with time-positioned event bars (left/width computed from start/end), grid lines, a live 'now' marker, colored tones, and clickable bars with a hover tooltip showing the event and its time range. Ideal for room bookings, shifts, and resource scheduling.

#### Sidebar Nav

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/sidebar-nav
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/sidebar-nav`
- **Description**: Dashboard sidebar with a brand header, grouped nav items, Lucide icons, trailing count badges, and an active state. Collapse is driven from the shell topbar via the `collapsed` prop (icon rail when true).

#### Talent Card

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/talent-card
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/talent-card`
- **Description**: A candidate/freelancer card: avatar with verified badge, star rating or new label, a location/rate split, and toggleable wishlist and invite actions that track their own state. Ideal for talent marketplaces and staffing grids.

#### User Menu

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/user-menu

- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/card27`
- **Description**: A compact community card with thumbnail, member count, and organizer row for directories and group lists.

#### Promo Card

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/card28
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/card28`
- **Description**: A dismissible promo card with image, deadline line, and apply button for programs and offers.

#### Testimonial Card

- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/card3`
- **Description**: A testimonial card with star rating, quote, and author row for reviews and social proof sections.

- **Description**: A product card with image, price, discount badge, wishlist toggle, and add to cart action for shop grids.

- **Description**: An article card with cover image, category chip, excerpt, and author row for blog and news grids.

- **Description**: A portfolio card with a full bleed image, hover zoom, and gradient title overlay for work showcases.

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/card7
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/card7`
- **Description**: A 3D tilt card that rotates in perspective toward the cursor with a moving glare for product showcases.

#### Team Reveal Card

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/card8
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/card8`
- **Description**: A team member card with a grayscale portrait that gains color on hover while a bio drawer slides up.

#### Gradient Beam Card

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/card9
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/card9`
- **Description**: A featured callout card wrapped in an orbiting gradient border beam for highlights and announcements.

### Filter

#### Checkbox Filter

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/filter-checkbox
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/filter-checkbox`
- **Description**: Multi-select checkbox list with optional result counts. Works controlled or uncontrolled, designed for filter sidebars and toolbars.

#### Chips Filter

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/filter-chips
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/filter-chips`
- **Description**: Multi-select button chips for compact option sets like sizes. Works controlled or uncontrolled.

#### Combobox Filter

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/filter-combobox
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/filter-combobox`
- **Description**: Searchable dropdown for very long option lists like brands. Type to narrow options, select one or many, and see result counts inline.

#### Multiselect Filter

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/filter-multiselect
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/filter-multiselect`
- **Description**: Dropdown with checkbox rows and a selection-count badge. Keeps many-option filters compact in toolbars where a checkbox list would not fit.

#### Radio Filter

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/filter-radio
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/filter-radio`
- **Description**: Single-select radio list with optional result counts. Clicking the active option clears the selection, so the filter is always escapable.

#### Min/Max Range Filter

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/filter-range
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/filter-range`
- **Description**: Paired number inputs for open-ended ranges: either side can stay empty, so users can filter by only a minimum or only a maximum.

#### Rating Filter

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/filter-rating
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/filter-rating`
- **Description**: Star rows for minimum-rating filtering in the familiar n-and-up pattern. Clicking the active row clears the selection.

#### Search Filter

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/filter-search
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/filter-search`
- **Description**: Text search input with a leading icon for keyword filtering. Debounce in the consumer if you fetch on change.

#### Segmented Filter

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/filter-segmented
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/filter-segmented`
- **Description**: Single-select segmented control built on Tabs for mutually exclusive choices like gender or condition. Clicking the active segment clears the selection.

#### Select Filter

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/filter-select
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/filter-select`
- **Description**: Single-select dropdown for long option lists that would crowd a sidebar. Supports a clear item, result counts, and a disabled state for dependent filters.

#### Range Slider Filter

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/filter-slider
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/filter-slider`
- **Description**: Two-thumb range slider with live numeric readouts and a commit callback, built for price ranges.

#### Color Swatch Filter

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/filter-swatch
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/filter-swatch`
- **Description**: Multi-select color circles for color filtering. Each option paints its own CSS color and stays accessible via screen-reader labels.

#### Toggle Filter

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/filter-toggle
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/filter-toggle`
- **Description**: Switch rows for boolean product flags like on-sale or in-stock. Multi-select, works controlled or uncontrolled.

#### Tree Filter

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/filter-tree
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/filter-tree`
- **Description**: Hierarchical checkbox tree for nested categories with expand/collapse rows. Checking a parent checks its whole subtree, and partially selected parents turn indeterminate.

### Inspector

#### Inspector Action

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/inspector-action
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/inspector-action`
- **Description**: The row that does something instead of holding something: open a sub-panel, replace an asset, regenerate a key, delete the section. It carries a description, a hint, a busy spinner and a destructive treatment, and renders as a plain anchor when given an href.

#### Inspector Align

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/inspector-align
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/inspector-align`
- **Description**: Where the contents of a box sit in it: nine cells drawn in visual terms, mapped onto justify and align afterwards so the pair swapping places under a column direction is the component's problem and not the reader's. Direction, distribution and stretch sit under the pad as rows of the family, since each is a setting like any other.

#### Inspector Angle

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/inspector-angle
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/inspector-angle`
- **Description**: Settings row for a direction: a dial you drag round, reading in degrees the way CSS does (zero up, growing clockwise), with a range input underneath carrying the keyboard and the form.

#### Inspector Aspect

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/inspector-aspect
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/inspector-aspect`
- **Description**: Settings row for a ratio: the row prints it and draws it, and opens an editor with the ratios worth a name plus both sides always editable. It is kept as two numbers rather than as their quotient, since 16:9 is what a reader recognises.

#### Inspector Attributes

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/inspector-attributes
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/inspector-attributes`
- **Description**: The pairs nobody could have put in the panel in advance: data-* hooks, an ARIA relationship, a custom property, an og: name. Two text fields per line and nothing else, with no reordering and no per-row editor. Duplicate names are marked rather than refused, since an edit passes through one on its way.

#### Inspector Border

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/inspector-border
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/inspector-border`
- **Description**: Settings row for a border: the row draws one exactly as described beside a summary of it, and opens an editor with the sides as icon toggles and the width, style and colour under them, each one a row of the family.

#### Inspector Clip

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/inspector-clip
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/inspector-clip`
- **Description**: The shape a box is cut to. Every thumbnail is drawn with the property it sets, so the grid is not a picture of the shapes but the shapes themselves, and a shape with a number in it brings its own slider out. Percentages throughout, so a shape survives a box that changes size.

#### Inspector Code

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/inspector-code
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/inspector-code`
- **Description**: Settings block for a snippet: a monospaced field with a language chip and a line count, Tab indenting instead of leaving, and a fixed height so a pasted stylesheet cannot push the rest of the drawer out of reach. Collapsible, since a snippet is the tallest thing in a drawer and the least often touched; folded, it measures exactly what a row measures and still reports its line count.

#### Inspector Color

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/inspector-color
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/inspector-color`
- **Description**: Settings row that keeps the label, the colour value and a swatch on one pill; pressing the row opens the OKLCH colour picker below it, which is where the value is edited.

#### Inspector Combobox

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/inspector-combobox
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/inspector-combobox`
- **Description**: Settings row for a list too long to read: pressing it opens a width-matched list with a search field, the keyboard walking the results while focus stays in the field. Options carry groups, descriptions, swatches and search keywords, and `multiple` turns the row into a counted multi-select.

#### Inspector Corners

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/inspector-corners
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/inspector-corners`
- **Description**: Settings row for the four corners of a box: the row carries a border-radius shorthand summary and a glyph rounded to match, and opens a square where each field sits on the corner it rounds.

#### Inspector Date

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/inspector-date
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/inspector-date`
- **Description**: Settings row for a date, a time, or both: the row reads the value the way anyone would write it down and opens a real month calendar, while a time on its own keeps the platform's own field inline, since a time has no month to show.

#### Inspector Dimensions

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/inspector-dimensions
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/inspector-dimensions`
- **Description**: Width and height on one row, with the lock between them: while it is closed, editing one scales the other by the ratio the pair had when the lock closed. Both fields are as wide as the largest number they can hold, so typing never shifts the row.

#### Inspector Easing

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/inspector-easing
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/inspector-easing`
- **Description**: Settings row for a cubic-bezier: the row names the preset and draws the curve small, and opens an editor with the two control points draggable, room above and below the run for an overshoot, and a strip that runs the motion so the choice can be watched rather than read.

#### Inspector Filters

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/inspector-filters
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/inspector-filters`
- **Description**: Settings row for a CSS filter stack, all ten functions of it: the row shows the whole stack applied to something, and opens an editor holding the nine numeric filters as rows of the family plus a drop shadow section, over a preview large enough to judge.

#### Inspector Gradient

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/inspector-gradient
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/inspector-gradient`
- **Description**: Settings row for a gradient: the row shows a strip of it, and opens an editor with draggable stops over the ramp, so one colour can hold a wider share than the next. The kind, the direction and the selected stop's colour and offset sit under it as rows of the family.

#### Inspector Group

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/inspector-group
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/inspector-group`
- **Description**: The container the rows go in: a named, collapsible section that says what it is currently set to while it is closed, with an optional reset in its header. A drawer of twenty settings becomes a drawer of five groups.

#### Inspector Icon

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/inspector-icon
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/inspector-icon`
- **Description**: Settings row that names the chosen icon and shows it on the right; pressing the row opens a searchable palette below it, width-matched to the row, with clearing offered at the foot of it. The icon set is passed in, so the row never bundles an icon library of its own.

#### Inspector Input

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/inspector-input
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/inspector-input`
- **Description**: Settings row with a label on the left and a plain text field on the right, sharing the family's pill: the whole row is the label, so pressing anywhere puts the caret in the field.

#### Inspector Link

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/inspector-link
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/inspector-link`
- **Description**: Settings row for a destination: the row reads the URL with its scheme stripped and marks whether it leaves the tab, and opens an editor holding an optional page menu, the URL field and the target and nofollow switches.

#### Inspector Media

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/inspector-media
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/inspector-media`
- **Description**: Settings row for an image or a video: the asset itself as a thumbnail on the right, and pressing the row opens a width-matched editor with the URL, a preview and a remove. Given a picker of your own, it hands the choosing to your media library instead.

#### Inspector Meter

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/inspector-meter
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/inspector-meter`
- **Description**: The row that reports rather than asks: a measurement the work produced, shown in the family's surface so it can sit among the settings that caused it. Threshold bands colour the bar and the number without the caller recomputing them, and it is a meter rather than a progress bar, which is how it is announced.

#### Inspector Multicolor

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/inspector-multicolor
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/inspector-multicolor`
- **Description**: Settings row for a list of colours: a swatch per stop, each opening the OKLCH picker, and a remove and add pair at the far right bounded by min and max.

#### Inspector Note

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/inspector-note
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/inspector-note`
- **Description**: The line of prose that belongs between rows: what a setting is for, why one is switched off, what a value will cost. Four tones, each with its own mark, and the same text size as the rows around it.

#### Inspector Position

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/inspector-position
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/inspector-position`
- **Description**: Settings row for a point on a surface: the row names the nine spots CSS names and shows the rest as two percentages, and opens a square pad the point is dragged around, with the thirds drawn on it and a pull towards them.

#### Inspector Range

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/inspector-range
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/inspector-range`
- **Description**: Settings row for a span rather than a value: two thumbs on the row itself, the band between them filling it, and both ends of the pair read out on the right. Ticks, tones and thumb states follow inspector-slider exactly, appearing on hover.

#### Inspector Row

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/inspector-row
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/inspector-row`
- **Description**: The family's escape hatch: label on the left, whatever you hand it on the right, and the same surface, metrics and focus ring as every other row, so a control the family does not have yet still looks like it belongs.

#### Inspector Scrub

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/inspector-scrub
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/inspector-scrub`
- **Description**: A number with no ends, dragged from the row itself: for the values that have no maximum worth naming, like a z-index, an X offset or a letter-spacing. The drag is relative rather than positional, so pressing anywhere is safe, and a soft range gives the bar something to draw against that the value is free to leave. Only the reported number is quantized, so the pointer never fights the grid.

#### Inspector Secret

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/inspector-secret
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/inspector-secret`
- **Description**: A value shown without being readable over a shoulder: an API key, a token, a signing secret. Hidden, it keeps its last few characters legible, since that tail is how one key is told from another; copy works whether or not it is revealed, and revealing fires a callback for panels that keep a log of it.

#### Inspector Segmented

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/inspector-segmented
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/inspector-segmented`
- **Description**: Settings row whose choices sit side by side on the right, with a marker that slides between them: the readable alternative to a switch when the two states deserve names, and the compact one to a select at three or four options.

#### Inspector Select

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/inspector-select
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/inspector-select`
- **Description**: Settings row that pairs a label with its current choice inside one pill, opening a width-matched dropdown below: option icons, colour swatches, descriptions and grouped sections, on top of the accessible shadcn select.

#### Inspector Shadow

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/inspector-shadow
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/inspector-shadow`
- **Description**: Settings row for a box shadow: the row shows the shadow itself, and opens an editor holding a larger preview with offset, blur, spread and colour under it, each one a row of the family.

#### Inspector Shortcut

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/inspector-shortcut
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/inspector-shortcut`
- **Description**: Settings row that records a key combination: press it, press the keys, and the row keeps them as kbd chips printed in the platform's own glyphs. Mod stands for Cmd on a Mac and Ctrl everywhere else, so one stored value is right on both.

#### Inspector Slider

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/inspector-slider
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/inspector-slider`
- **Description**: Compact settings row where the label and the live value sit inside the track: magnetic tick snapping, a rubber band when you overdrag, Shift for precision, Alt-click to reset, wheel and typed input, on a native range input for full accessibility.

#### Inspector Spacing

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/inspector-spacing
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/inspector-spacing`
- **Description**: Settings row for the four edges of a box: the row carries a CSS-shorthand summary, and opens a cross where each field sits on the edge it sets, tied together or not.

#### Inspector Stepper

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/inspector-stepper
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/inspector-stepper`
- **Description**: Settings row for a bounded number: minus and plus either side of a typeable value, with hold-to-repeat, Shift for coarse steps and full keyboard stepping.

#### Inspector Switch

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/inspector-switch
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/inspector-switch`
- **Description**: Settings row with a label on the left and a switch on the right, sharing the family's pill: the label takes the row's spare width, so a press almost anywhere toggles it.

#### Inspector Tabs

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/inspector-tabs
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/inspector-tabs`
- **Description**: The strip that splits a settings panel into two or three questions instead of one long scroll. It is the strip and nothing else: what the tabs switch between stays in the panel's own markup, beside the state that decides it. The pill slides between equal columns, arrow keys both move and select, and a tab can carry a count of what has changed under it.

#### Inspector Tags

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/inspector-tags
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/inspector-tags`
- **Description**: Settings block for a list of short strings: tags are typed one after another and wrap under the label, a comma or a paste splits several at once, and Backspace on an empty field reaches back into the list. Collapsible, so a long list folds down to the height of a row with the count still on it.

#### Inspector Textarea

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/inspector-textarea
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/inspector-textarea`
- **Description**: The family's block row: the same surface and tones, but the label sits above a multi-line field whose height comes from the text, with a character count whenever there is a limit to see. Collapsible, so a paragraph written once can be folded down to the height of a row without leaving the form.

#### Inspector Toggles

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/inspector-toggles
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/inspector-toggles`
- **Description**: Settings row holding a set of pills that are each on or off, so any number of them can be on at once: what inspector-segmented is for one choice out of several, this is for several choices at once, and what inspector-switch is for a single flag, this is for a handful that belong together.

#### Inspector Tracks

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/inspector-tracks
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/inspector-tracks`
- **Description**: The columns of a grid as a list of lengths: the row shows the CSS it comes to, the editor holds one length per line with a picture of the shares above them. There is no reordering on purpose, because a track's place in the list is its place in the grid.

#### Inspector Transition

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/inspector-transition
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/inspector-transition`
- **Description**: How long a change takes, when it starts, and the shape of it, in one row instead of three that drift apart. The editor runs the real transition on a loop rather than drawing its curve, since what a reader needs to know is whether 300ms feels slow.

#### Inspector Unit

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/inspector-unit
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/inspector-unit`
- **Description**: A number and the unit that gives it meaning, in one row: px, rem, a percentage, or a keyword like auto that is the whole value on its own. Each unit may bring its own range, so a percentage stops at 100 while pixels do not.

#### Inspector Variants

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/inspector-variants
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/inspector-variants`
- **Description**: The choice that has to be seen to be made: a template, a layout, a chart type. Each option is a picture, normally a rendered screenshot passed as a URL, or markup for the choices no photograph would show. The row is the trigger, the grid is width-matched to it, and the captions under the pictures can be dropped for a set whose pictures say everything.

### Text

#### Word Stagger

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/text1
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/text1`
- **Description**: Text that settles in one word at a time, each word rising a few pixels out of a soft blur. Plays on scroll by default, or immediately for heroes.

#### Photo Fill

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/text10
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/text10`
- **Description**: Large serif letters filled with a photograph that drifts slowly inside them as the page scrolls, the picture showing through the type.

#### Ink Drying

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/text11
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/text11`
- **Description**: Words that begin as soft, spread blots of ink, wide-set and out of focus, and dry into crisp, tightly set type one after another.

#### Slow Wave

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/text12
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/text12`
- **Description**: A word whose letters rise and fall on one slow, continuous swell, each a beat behind the last, like a line of type resting on water. Stays still when reduced motion is preferred.

#### Fog Clearing

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/text13
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/text13`
- **Description**: Text hidden behind fog that clears across it from left to right along one soft edge, so the words emerge in reading order without moving at all.

#### Letters Settling

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/text14
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/text14`
- **Description**: A short word whose letters begin scattered and slightly turned, then drift home on a soft spring one after another, like type settling onto a page.

#### Running Line

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/text15
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/text15`
- **Description**: A single line of text that runs across its container without end, fading at both edges and pausing under the pointer. Small caps for announcements, tracked serif for statements.

#### Highlight Sweep

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/text16
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/text16`
- **Description**: An inline phrase that gets a soft highlight swept in behind it from the left when it scrolls into view, like a marker drawn across the words, without the text moving.

#### Rolling Digits

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/text17
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/text17`
- **Description**: A number whose digits roll like an odometer, each column sliding to its new figure a beat after the last, whenever the value changes. For prices that switch with a toggle, years, and live counters that climb on their own.

#### Circle Text

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/text18
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/text18`
- **Description**: A line of text set around a circle that turns slowly, with room in the middle for an initial, an icon or a short word. A seal for corners, footers and hero edges.

#### Strike and Replace

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/text19
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/text19`
- **Description**: A sentence that corrects itself: a line is drawn through the old word from left to right, and the better word settles in beside it out of a soft blur.

#### Line Reveal

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/text2
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/text2`
- **Description**: Lines of text that rise into view out of their own clipped rows, one after another, the way a heading is unmasked line by line.

#### Letter Cascade

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/text3
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/text3`
- **Description**: Short text whose characters arrive one by one out of a light blur, for eyebrows, labels and single words. The element keeps the whole string as its accessible name.

#### Turning Word

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/text4
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/text4`
- **Description**: A sentence whose one word takes turns: each candidate blurs up into place as the last blurs out, on a timer that stops when reduced motion is preferred.

#### Scroll Highlight

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/text5
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/text5`
- **Description**: A passage whose words brighten one after another in reading order as it scrolls through the viewport, and dim again on the way back, like a finger following the line.

#### Typewriter

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/text6
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/text6`
- **Description**: Text typed out one character at a time behind a thin caret that keeps a slow pulse once the line is finished. The element keeps the whole string as its accessible name.

#### Count Up

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/text7
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/text7`
- **Description**: A figure that counts up from zero to its value the first time it scrolls into view, with a prefix, a suffix, decimals and thousands grouping, in tabular numerals so nothing shifts.

#### Underline Draw

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/text8
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/text8`
- **Description**: An inline phrase whose hairline underline draws itself in from the left when it scrolls into view. Drop it inside a heading or a sentence to mark the words that matter.

#### Soft Blur In

- **URL**: https://ui.beste.co/component/text9
- **Install**: `npx shadcn add https://ui.beste.co/component/r/text9`
- **Description**: A paragraph or heading that arrives as one piece, rising a few pixels out of a soft blur when it scrolls into view. The quiet companion to the word stagger, for body copy and descriptions.
